shortBio.en: Ramones guitar; Mosrite downstrokes, policy of no leads.
shortBio.zh: Ramones 吉他；Mosrite 下行扫弦，原则上不独奏。

body.en:
Born John Cummings, 1948. Strict downstroke discipline defines US punk timing. Refuses lead breaks by method. Leather-jacket stage stillness is part of the brand.

Guitar method is the structural export.
body.zh:
本名 John Cummings，1948 年生。严格下行扫弦纪律定义美国朋克时值。方法上拒绝主音段落。皮衣舞台静止是品牌一部分。

吉他方法是结构出口。
